subject: Request: Short-term exception to deletion policy for live replay
messages:
From: Alice Romero <alice.romero@regenmedinc.com>
To: support@redwood-inference.com, karthik_iyer
Cc: Procurement <procurement@regenmedinc.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Need short-term retention hold for live replay (production)

Hi team,

We hit a production regression during a customer demo this morning where generated outputs diverged from expected by policy filters. Our engineering team needs a short-lived live replay of a subset of inference sessions to reproduce the exact inputs and KV cache behavior. From our side we can scope this to: model instance id "rm-prod-03", timeframe 2028-03-27 07:30-08:15 PT, and user sessions for tenant "regenmed-prod".

I understand Redwood has a deletion window that would remove ephemeral traces after 24 hours. This data would normally be purged by 2028-03-27 08:40. Regenerating the exact sequence without the original network traces and session logs is unlikely. Can you advise whether a time-bound exception can be made for debugging? Preferably a 72-hour hold and a private transfer location so our engineers can replay locally.

Attaching a redacted session manifest and a screenshot. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Thanks,
Alice Romero
Engineering Ops | RegenMed Inc.
attachments: session-manifest-regenmed.csv (csv), screenshot-403.png (png)
From: karthik_iyer
To: neha_kapoor, vanessa_ortiz, marissa_cole, vivek_kulkarni
Cc: Alice Romero <alice.romero@regenmedinc.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:49:10 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Urgent: Need short-term retention hold for live replay (production)

Team — forwarding an ask from RegenMed. They are requesting a temporary suspension of the standard ephemeral deletion for a narrowly scoped set of sessions to enable a live replay for debugging. Key points:
- Scope: model instance rm-prod-03, tenant regenmed-prod, window 07:30–08:15 PT (UTC-7)
- Requested hold: 72 hours and access for RegenMed engineers to pull artifacts to their environment
- Customer claims deletion cutoff is ~08:40 today

Questions for approvals:
1) Is there a path to grant a 72-hour retention carveout strictly limited to these artifacts?
2) Can we provide an S3-limited, access-logged export (encrypted) instead of enabling long-term retention inside Redwood?
3) Any legal/contractual sign-off needed from procurement or privacy?

I've included Alice on thread for clarifications. If we need to escalate to security/compliance/legal quickly, please advise.

-Karthik
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor
To: karthik_iyer, vanessa_ortiz, marissa_cole, vivek_kulkarni
Cc: Alice Romero <alice.romero@regenmedinc.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 10:22:31 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: Need short-term retention hold for live replay (production)

Karthik — thanks for the context. A few points from Security/Privacy: 

- Short-term exceptions are allowable but we need a documented minimal-scope justification and an auditable workplan. Please have RegenMed confirm the exact list of session ids or user hashes.
- We prefer an export model: create a time-limited export to the customer's S3 (or a pre-signed s3 URL controlled by customer), with server-side encryption and access logging enabled. This avoids changing our retention settings globally.
- If the export includes any sensitive PII fields, we require redaction before transfer or a signed limited-scope Data Processing Addendum (DPA) amendment.
- For internal authorization I will need: (a) ticket link, (b) named Redwood engineers who will touch the artifacts, (c) precise retention TTL (hours), and (d) confirmation that copies will be destroyed from customer's side after the window.

If regenmed can accept an export-only approach with a 48–72 hour TTL, and provide session ids, we can approve quickly. Vanessa — any procurement/legal flag here?

-Neha
Security & Privacy
Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz
To: karthik_iyer, neha_kapoor, marissa_cole, vivek_kulkarni
Cc: Alice Romero <alice.romero@regenmedinc.com>, Procurement <procurement@regenmedinc.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 13:10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: Need short-term retention hold for live replay (production)

I've reviewed RegenMed's ask and the proposed controls. Legal is comfortable with a narrowly-scoped, export-first approach under the following conditions: 

1) Export ONLY: Redwood will create a time-limited export package for the specific sessions. No change to platform retention rules.
2) TTL: 48 hours maximum on the exported artifact in customer's S3. If RegenMed needs longer, Procurement must submit a formal request and the customer must sign the DPA addendum (I attached a template).
3) Data minimization: Redwood will redact any obvious patient identifiers before export. RegenMed must provide the session IDs and confirm scope.
4) Audit & access: All access by Redwood engineers will be logged and reviewed. Export will be encrypted with a per-export key stored in Redwood KMS, and we will provide an audit bundle after transfer.
5) No downstream copies policy: RegenMed must confirm they will not create additional backups; a formal confirmation email is required prior to transfer.

Karthik — you have sign-off from Legal and Security for a 48-hour export with the controls above. Marissa/Vivek — please coordinate the export task and post the INF ticket.

-Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: DPA-addendum-template.docx (docx)
From: karthik_iyer
To: Alice Romero <alice.romero@regenmedinc.com>, neha_kapoor, vanessa_ortiz, marissa_cole, vivek_kulkarni
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Need short-term retention hold for live replay (production)

Alice — thank you for the quick response. Per Legal and Security, we will not modify platform deletion rules. Instead Redwood will produce a scoped, encrypted export for the RM engineers with a 48-hour TTL in the destination bucket. Conditions:
- You must send session ids (or user hashes) for the exact items to be included by 19:00 PT today.
- Confirm that you will not retain secondary backups beyond the 48-hour TTL; reply to this thread to confirm.
- We'll redact obvious patient identifiers before export; any fields you require redacted, note them in your reply.

Next steps from our side: Marissa and Vivek will create INF-4921 and prepare the export package. We will provide a link to a pre-signed S3 upload (or to your pre-provisioned S3) and the encryption key will be rotated after transfer. After transfer completes we will provide the audit bundle and a deletion confirmation.

Attached: repro-steps.md (internal), session-logs-20280327.tar.gz (internal sample)

If RegenMed can confirm the session ids and the no-copy acknowledgement, we'll proceed. We can also set up a 30-minute checkpoint call if helpful.

-Karthik
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
